item.title: Extension Service Holds Free Gardening Class At The Molino Library
item.description: Escambia Extension and Master Gardener volunteers held a Spring Gardening Class recently at the Molino LIbrary. The program provided information on how to start a spring garden from seeds while building skills on garden tool prep. Photos for NorthEscambia.com, click to enlarge.
